core_idea: Dieci Assoc. South Section 4 Director Meursault is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist — **Sinking** stacker — payoff coins check **4+ Sinking**, so build the count before committing them. Sinking drains SP when the afflicted unit is hit. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 6 Sinking (max +2); +5% damage per Insight (max +15%).
playstyle_guide:
- Front-load **+6 Aggro** on the slot you want enemies to target.
- Pair high-Aggro turns with this kit's own defensive tools so its under-pressure passives actually trigger.
- Discard into **Erudition** for Shield spikes, then use the powered skill line.
- Discard to build **Insight**, then fire the powered skill set.
- Build Insight Count — spend via S3 once you hit 4+.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 6 Sinking (max +2).
- Hold S3 for when At 4+ Insight is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.

**S1 — Studious Dedication** (BP 3, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- Gain (Insight x 5% of Max HP) Shield if this Skill is Discarded ; [On Use] Discard 1 Skill of the lowest rank in all of this unit's Skill Slots ; [On Use] Gain (Insight - 1) Clash Power (max 2) ; [Clash Win] Gain 2 Erudition (once per turn)

**S2 — Moment of Erudition** (BP 4, CP +6, 2 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average / Extremely High stacked).
- Deal +5% damage for every Insight on self (max 15%) ; [Combat Start] Apply Erudition equal to Insight on self to 2 random allies and on self (prioritizes allies with Discard that has the least Erudition) ; [On Use] Discard 2 of this unit's Skills in ascending order of ranks from all of its Skill Slots ; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 6 Sinking on target (max 2)
- **Coin Power** scales with **Sinking** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Up to **+15% damage** (+5% per **Insight**) — stack the resource before committing.

**S3 — Scorch Knowledge** (BP 5, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / High stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: Deal +5% damage for every Insight (max 45%) | [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 6 Sinking on target (max 2).
- **Coin Power** scales with **Sinking** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.

Combat passive — **Study Hall**: Every time another ally Discards a Skill, apply 1 Erudition to the ally and self (once per Skill, 3 times per turn).
  - Turn End: next turn, gain Pierce DMG Up and Blunt DMG Up equal to the number of other allies that Discarded Skills (max 3).

Combat passive — **Diligent Learning**: When 1 ally with the highest max HP Discards a Skill, gain (5 x Discarded Skill rank)% of the max HP as Shield (once per turn).
  - If the ally has Insight, multiply the above Shield value by 1.5.
